initialExam.title: SUPER TET (UP) 2026
initialExam.description: SUPER TET for recruitment of assistant teachers in UP primary and upper primary schools. Requires CTET/UPTET qualification.
initialExam.syllabus: Language: Hindi/English/Sanskrit (40 marks), Science (10 marks), Maths (20 marks), Environmental & Social Studies (10 marks), Teaching Methodology (10 marks), Child Psychology (10 marks), GK/Current Affairs (30 marks), Reasoning (5 marks), IT (5 marks), Life Skills/Management (10 marks).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Merit List → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Teacher in UP primary and upper primary schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: Assistant Teacher → Head Master → Block Education Officer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit updeled.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Vacation, State government benefits
